findings.reason: without a `change_lane` case the gate cannot show the section's own assertion holds, so a run moved to another lane could still drop its figures and close green.
findings.text: the done-when's third case resumes a run and checks the resumed argv, but names no case for `change_lane`, though the same sentence claims both `resume_plan` and `change_lane` pass the images, so a worker that implements only the resume path passes the stated gate while the lane-change claim stays unverified
